summary: Teaching with #knownchat was great. This summer using webmentions and post types on WordPress improved my classes. I wish I could use Known in my intro classes but I can't start any class with, "Well go to the repo, download the latest build, fire up FTP...."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Teaching with #knownchat was great. This summer using webmentions and post types on WordPress improved my classes. I wish I could use Known in my intro classes but I can't start any class with, "Well go to the repo, download the latest build, fire up FTP...."
